name: 54494 · Wisc Rapids, WI
findings: ZIP 54494 (Wisc Rapids) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54494 (Wisc Rapids) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
